works.description: A service proposing living memorials: a person's DNA is encoded into the genome of a tree using Joe Davis's transcription method, making the tree a carrier of memory without changing how it grows.
works.description_zh: 一项提出「活体纪念碑」的服务：用 Joe Davis 的转写方法把某人的 DNA 编码进树的基因组，让树成为记忆载体，而不改变它的生长方式。
works.idea_en: A grave that grows, with the person's code written into non-coding DNA.
works.idea_zh: 一座会生长的墓：人的编码被写进非编码 DNA 中。
works.method: Human DNA sequence is translated by Davis's DNA Manifold algorithm into a sequence inserted into the tree genome at sites chosen to leave phenotype unchanged; the project was framed as a commercial service.
works.method_zh: 用 Davis 的 DNA Manifold 算法把人类 DNA 序列转写成插入树基因组的序列，插入位点选在不改变表型之处；项目以商业服务的形式呈现。

works.title: The Eighth Day
works.description: A clear dome holds a small ecology of transgenic organisms that all glow green — plants, amoebae, fish and mice — together with a biobot moved by amoeba activity.
works.description_zh: 一个透明穹顶中放着一个全部发绿光的转基因生态系统——植物、变形虫、鱼和老鼠——以及一个由变形虫活动驱动的生物机器人。
works.idea_en: Assemble transgenic life into one artificial ecology and watch it become a shared condition.
works.idea_zh: 把转基因生命组装成一个人工生态系统，看它变成一种共同处境。
works.method: GFP-expressing organisms are kept in a four-foot acrylic dome with life-support; a biobot with an amoeba colony as its brain moves according to their collective activity, streamed online.
works.method_zh: 表达 GFP 的生物被养在带生命支持的四英尺亚克力穹顶中；以变形虫群落为「大脑」的生物机器人依其集体活动移动，并在线直播。

works.title: Bacterial Radio
works.description: Engineered bacteria deposit semiconducting minerals on glass, producing the crystal-radio components of a working receiver grown rather than manufactured.
works.description_zh: 工程细菌在玻璃上沉积半导体矿物，长出（而非制造出）可工作的矿石收音机元件。
works.idea_en: Grow the electronics: bacteria as a fabrication step for a radio.
works.idea_zh: 让电子器件生长出来：把细菌当作收音机的一道制造工序。
works.method: E. coli carrying genes for metal-binding proteins precipitate germanium and other semiconducting compounds in patterns on substrates, which are wired into a crystal radio circuit.
works.method_zh: 携带金属结合蛋白基因的大肠杆菌在基底上按图案沉淀锗等半导体化合物，再接入矿石收音机电路。

works.title: Relative Velocity Inscription Device
works.description: A live gel electrophoresis race between DNA samples from four members of the artist's mixed-race family, running for the length of the exhibition.
works.description_zh: 一场持续整个展期的活体凝胶电泳「竞赛」，参赛者是艺术家混血家庭四位成员的 DNA 样本。
works.idea_en: Turn the apparatus of genetic comparison into a visible contest, and its politics show.
works.idea_zh: 把基因比较的装置变成一场可见的竞赛，它的政治就显露出来。
works.method: A custom horizontal electrophoresis system separates family members' DNA over weeks; the migrating bands are lit and monitored, with skin-colour genetics as the stated premise.
works.method_zh: 定制的水平电泳系统在数周内分离家庭成员的 DNA；迁移的条带被照明并监测，作品以皮肤颜色的遗传学为前提。

works.title: Invisible
works.description: Two sprays sold as a kit: one deletes most of the DNA a person leaves behind, the other replaces it with a confusing mixture of other people's DNA.
works.description_zh: 作为套件出售的两种喷雾：一种清除人留下的大部分 DNA，另一种用他人 DNA 的混合物覆盖其上。
works.idea_en: If DNA is surveillance data, then counter-forensics can be a consumer product.
works.idea_zh: 如果 DNA 是监控数据，那么反取证也可以是一件消费品。
works.method: Erase uses a bleach-based cleanser that degrades DNA on surfaces; Replace applies a mix of DNA from many sources so any recovered sample yields an unusable profile.
works.method_zh: Erase 使用含次氯酸的清洁剂降解表面 DNA；Replace 喷上来自多个来源的 DNA 混合物，使任何采集样本都得不到可用图谱。

works.title: Probably Chelsea
works.description: Thirty different 3D-printed portrait masks, all generated from Chelsea Manning's DNA, hang together to show how many faces one genome can be read as.
works.description_zh: 三十个不同的 3D 打印肖像面具，全部由 Chelsea Manning 的 DNA 生成，并排悬挂，显示同一份基因组可以被读成多少张脸。
works.idea_en: One genome, thirty faces: DNA phenotyping is interpretation, not identification.
works.idea_zh: 一份基因组，三十张脸：DNA 表型推断是解释，不是识别。
works.method: Genotype data from a cheek swab and hair sent by Manning is run through the artist's phenotyping algorithms with different parameters, and each resulting face is 3D printed in translucent plastic.
works.method_zh: 把 Manning 寄来的口腔擦拭样本与头发的基因型数据，用艺术家的表型算法以不同参数运算，每张生成的脸都用半透明塑料 3D 打印。

works.title: (Im)possible Baby
works.description: Using the genome data of a real same-sex couple, the project simulates the children they could have and presents them as a family photo album and a television documentary.
works.description_zh: 项目用一对真实同性伴侣的基因组数据模拟他们可能拥有的孩子，并以家庭相册和电视纪录片的形式呈现。
works.idea_en: Make the speculative child concrete enough that the family, and the law, have to respond.
works.idea_zh: 把思辨中的孩子做得足够具体，让家庭和法律都不得不回应。
works.method: Consumer genotyping data from both partners is combined to predict plausible offspring traits, which are used to generate portraits and staged family scenes, aired on NHK in Japan.
works.method_zh: 把双方的消费级基因检测数据结合，预测可能的后代特征，据此生成肖像与家庭场景，并在日本 NHK 播出。

works.title: Transfigurations
works.description: Silicone infant models show surgical modifications a parent might choose — a heat-dissipating skull, a caffeine-absorbing patch, a facial change for social advantage.
works.description_zh: 硅胶婴儿模型展示父母可能选择的手术改造：散热的头骨、吸收咖啡因的贴片、为社会优势而做的面部改变。
works.idea_en: If the body is designable, the first client is a parent making decisions for someone else.
works.idea_zh: 如果身体是可设计的，第一个客户是替别人做决定的父母。
works.method: Hyper-real silicone babies are sculpted with plausible post-operative results, presented as if from a medical catalogue to test where a viewer's objection begins.
works.method_zh: 用超写实硅胶雕塑出貌似术后的婴儿，以医疗图册的口吻呈现，测试观众的反对从哪里开始。

works.title: Circumventive Organs
works.description: Three fictional organs printed from a mix of cells taken from different species and body parts, each designed to pre-empt a specific medical emergency.
works.description_zh: 三个虚构器官，由取自不同物种和身体部位的细胞混合打印而成，各自用于预先阻止一种特定的医疗紧急情况。
works.idea_en: If organs can be printed from mixed cells, medicine starts designing new organs, not repairing old ones.
works.idea_zh: 如果器官能用混合细胞打印，医学就会开始设计新器官，而不是修补旧的。
works.method: Each proposal recombines known cell behaviours — electric eel electrocytes, rattlesnake muscle, tracheal cilia — into a printable organ, realised as a detailed physical model.
works.method_zh: 每个方案把已知的细胞行为（电鳗发电细胞、响尾蛇肌肉、气管纤毛）重组成一个可打印器官，并做成精细实物模型。

works.title: Algaculture
works.description: A wearable symbiosis suit of glass tubes lets a person grow and drink algae fed by their own exhaled breath and sunlight, proposing partly photosynthetic humans.
works.description_zh: 一件由玻璃管构成的共生服装，让人用自己呼出的气与阳光培养并饮用藻类，提出部分靠光合作用生存的人类。
works.idea_en: Design the human into the food chain rather than at the end of it.
works.idea_zh: 把人设计进食物链里，而不是放在食物链末端。
works.method: Blown-glass vessels worn on the body circulate a microalgae culture that takes in exhaled carbon dioxide and light; the wearer drinks the culture, a scenario developed with algae researchers.
works.method_zh: 佩戴在身上的吹制玻璃容器循环微藻培养液，吸收呼出的二氧化碳与光照；佩戴者饮用培养液，该情境与藻类研究者共同开发。

works.title: Designs for an Overpopulated Planet: Foragers
works.description: Prototypes of digestive devices for people who, facing food scarcity, use synthetic biology and animal digestion to extract nutrition from roadside plants.
works.description_zh: 为面对粮食短缺的人设计的消化装置原型：他们借合成生物学与动物的消化方式，从路边植物中获取营养。
works.idea_en: Take matters into your own gut: DIY biology as survival equipment.
works.idea_zh: 把事情交给自己的肠道：把 DIY 生物学当作生存装备。
works.method: Each foraging device combines mechanical processing with cultures and enzymes borrowed from ruminants and microbes, presented as worn prototypes with a field film.
works.method_zh: 每件觅食装置把机械处理与取自反刍动物和微生物的培养物、酶结合，以佩戴原型和田野影片呈现。

works.title: Sugababe
works.description: A living replica of Van Gogh's severed ear, grown from cartilage cells engineered with DNA from a Van Gogh descendant and kept alive in a nutrient case visitors can speak into.
works.description_zh: 梵高被割下的耳朵的活体复制品：用带有梵高后裔 DNA 的软骨细胞培养而成，保存在观众可以对其说话的营养舱中。
works.idea_en: Genetic relatedness used as a material for art history, with a live tissue as the artefact.
works.idea_zh: 把遗传亲缘当作艺术史的材料，而展品是活着的组织。
works.method: Cartilage cells from a great-great-grandson of Van Gogh's brother are engineered and grown on a printed ear-shaped scaffold in a bioreactor; a microphone and processor relay visitors' voices as nerve-like signals.
works.method_zh: 取自梵高弟弟曾曾孙的软骨细胞经改造后在生物反应器中的耳形打印支架上培养；麦克风与处理器把观众声音转成类神经信号传入。

works.title: Heirloom
works.description: Living portraits of the artist's two daughters, grown from their own skin cells onto glass casts of their faces, made with cell biologist John Hunt.
works.description_zh: 艺术家两个女儿的活体肖像：用她们自身的皮肤细胞在其面部玻璃铸型上培养而成，与细胞生物学家 John Hunt 合作。
works.idea_en: A family portrait made of the sitter, which has to be fed to stay a likeness.
works.idea_zh: 一幅由被画者本人构成的家庭肖像，必须被喂养才能维持相似。
works.method: Skin cells taken from the daughters are cultured onto glass face casts in a bioreactor over months; the growing cell sheet gradually takes on the features of the cast.
works.method_zh: 取自女儿的皮肤细胞在生物反应器中于玻璃面模上培养数月，生长的细胞层逐渐呈现出面模的特征。

works.title: Biological Atelier
works.description: A fictional couture house whose collections are grown rather than sewn: ivory jewellery, shark-tooth pieces and skin textiles cultured from cells on embroidered scaffolds.
works.description_zh: 一个虚构的高级定制工坊，其系列是生长出来而非缝制出来的：象牙首饰、鲨齿饰品和在刺绣支架上培养的皮肤织物。
works.idea_en: If materials are grown, luxury can use ivory and skin without any animal.
works.idea_zh: 如果材料是生长出来的，奢侈品就能用象牙和皮肤，而不需要动物。
works.method: Digitally embroidered scaffolds are seeded with cells in a lab, and the resulting samples are presented as seasonal collections with fabricated brand and process documentation.
works.method_zh: 把数码刺绣支架在实验室接种细胞，所得样本以季节系列的形式呈现，并配有虚构的品牌与工艺文档。

works.title: Tissue Engineered Textiles
works.description: A working research practice in which embroidered scaffolds are seeded with cells in a tissue-culture lab, producing sample books of textiles that were grown in place.
works.description_zh: 一项实际的研究实践：在组织培养实验室把细胞播种到刺绣支架上，做出「原位生长」的织物样本册。
works.idea_en: Bring the craft methods of textile design — sampling, stitching, archives — into the cell lab.
works.idea_zh: 把纺织设计的手艺方法——打样、缝制、样本档案——带进细胞实验室。
works.method: Scaffolds embroidered from silk and degradable threads are sterilised, seeded with fibroblasts or osteoblasts and cultured; stitch density and thread choice control where tissue forms.
works.method_zh: 用丝线与可降解线刺绣的支架经灭菌后接种成纤维细胞或成骨细胞培养；针迹密度与线材选择决定组织在哪里形成。

works.title: Open Source Estrogen
works.description: A set of DIY protocols, workshops and videos for detecting and extracting estrogen from bodies and water using kitchen equipment, distributed as open documentation.
works.description_zh: 一套用厨房器具检测和提取身体与水中雌激素的 DIY 协议、工作坊与影像，以开放文档形式分发。
works.idea_en: Hormones are an environmental and political material, so the protocol is the artwork.
works.idea_zh: 荷尔蒙是一种环境与政治材料，因此协议本身就是作品。
works.method: Low-cost extraction from urine and water samples, yeast estrogen biosensors and instructional formats including a soap-opera style video make hormone work reproducible outside clinics.
works.method_zh: 用低成本方法从尿液和水样中提取，配合酵母雌激素生物传感器，以及肥皂剧式教学影像，让荷尔蒙操作在诊所之外可复现。

works.title: In Posse
works.description: With stem cell scientist Susana Chuva de Sousa Lopes, Jarvis works towards making sperm from a female body, alongside a 'female' semen made from the bodily fluids of many contributors.
works.description_zh: Jarvis 与干细胞科学家 Susana Chuva de Sousa Lopes 合作，试图用女性身体制造精子，并以众多参与者的体液制成一份「女性」精液。
works.idea_en: Unmake one of biology's assumed asymmetries and see what social forms follow.
works.idea_zh: 拆掉生物学中一项被默认的不对称，看看随之而来的社会形式。
works.method: Induced pluripotent stem cells from the artist are differentiated towards germ cells in the Leiden lab, while a plasma-like 'semen' is composed from donated fluids and used in performances.
works.method_zh: 艺术家的诱导多能干细胞在莱顿实验室向生殖细胞方向分化；同时用捐赠体液配制类血浆「精液」，用于表演。

works.title: Glowing Sushi Cooking Show
works.description: A cooking show in which fluorescent GM aquarium fish are prepared as sushi, using a pet-shop transgenic animal to make debates about GM food edible.
works.description_zh: 一场烹饪节目，把荧光转基因观赏鱼做成寿司，用宠物店里的转基因动物把关于转基因食品的争论变成可以吃的东西。
works.idea_en: Serve the genetically modified organism that is already legal and watch the argument change.
works.idea_zh: 把已经合法的转基因生物端上桌，看争论如何转向。
works.method: GloFish bought as pets are filleted and served under UV light in a performed cooking show, with the legal and regulatory status of each organism discussed as part of the recipe.
works.method_zh: 把作为宠物购买的 GloFish 切片，在紫外光下的表演式烹饪节目中端上，并把每种生物的法律与监管状态作为食谱的一部分讨论。

works.title: Salivations
works.description: Chewing gum chewed by four displaced dogs is cast into architectural forms and paired with DNA sequencing of the microbes that the dogs and their humans share.
works.description_zh: 四只流离失所的狗咀嚼过的口香糖被铸成建筑形态，并配以对狗与主人共享微生物的 DNA 测序结果。
works.idea_en: Shared saliva as evidence of shared life: a microbiome as a record of migration.
works.idea_zh: 共享的唾液作为共同生活的证据：微生物组是一份迁徙记录。
works.method: Gum chewed by the dogs is collected, sterilised and formed into structures with the architecture collective elii; DNA from the samples is sequenced to identify shared oral microbiota.
works.method_zh: 收集狗咀嚼过的口香糖，灭菌后与建筑团体 elii 一起塑成结构；对样本 DNA 测序以识别共享的口腔微生物群。

works.title: Three-Dimensional Bioprinting of Thick Vascularized Tissues
works.description: Printed tissue more than a centimetre thick is kept alive for six weeks by perfusing its printed vascular network on a chip, with bone cells maturing inside.
works.description_zh: 厚度超过一厘米的打印组织，通过芯片上打印出的血管网络灌流，存活六周，内部的骨细胞持续成熟。
works.idea_en: Thickness is a plumbing problem, and printed plumbing plus perfusion solves it.
works.idea_zh: 厚度是管路问题，而打印出的管路加上灌流解决了它。
works.method: Cell-laden inks, extracellular matrix and a fugitive ink are co-printed inside a perfusion chip; after the fugitive ink is removed, endothelial cells line the channels and medium is pumped for weeks.
works.method_zh: 载细胞墨水、细胞外基质与逃逸墨水在灌流芯片内共同打印；去除逃逸墨水后，内皮细胞铺衬通道，培养液连续泵送数周。

paper.title: Three-dimensional bioprinting of thick vascularized tissues

works.title: ReConstruct: 3D Bioprinted Vascularized Fat Tissue
works.description: Printed vascularised fat tissue is developed as a soft-tissue graft for breast reconstruction after mastectomy, built from a patient's own cells.
works.description_zh: 打印出的血管化脂肪组织被开发为乳房切除术后重建用的软组织移植物，以病人自身细胞构建。
works.idea_en: Design the replacement for soft tissue, not just the structural parts of the body.
works.idea_zh: 要设计的是软组织的替代物，而不只是身体的结构件。
works.method: Adipose-derived stem cells and endothelial cells are printed as organ building blocks with embedded vascular channels, then perfused so the graft survives at clinically useful volumes.
works.method_zh: 把脂肪来源干细胞与内皮细胞作为器官构件打印，内嵌血管通道，再灌流使移植物在临床所需体积下存活。

works.title: Quorum
works.description: Faber Futures and Evolutor evolve mixed microbial communities that eat food-industry waste — oat milk residue, restaurant waste — and return high-performance textile pigments.
works.description_zh: Faber Futures 与 Evolutor 培育混合微生物群落，让它们以食品工业废料（燕麦奶残渣、餐厅废弃物）为食，产出高性能纺织颜料。
works.idea_en: Design the microbial community and the waste stream together, not the organism alone.
works.idea_zh: 要一起设计微生物群落和废料流，而不是只设计单一生物。
works.method: Streptomyces consortia are directed-evolved to digest complex sugars from specific waste streams; pigment output is characterised for textile dyeing and documented as a regenerative production system.
works.method_zh: 用定向进化让 Streptomyces 群落消化特定废料流中的复杂糖类；对色素产出进行纺织染色表征，并作为再生生产体系记录下来。

works.title: MyBacon (MyForest Foods)
works.description: Slabs of pure mycelium grown in vertical farms are cured and sliced into bacon strips, sold in supermarkets as a whole-cut meat alternative with no extrusion.
works.description_zh: 在垂直农场生长的纯菌丝体块经腌制后切成培根片，作为无需挤压成型的整块肉替代品在超市出售。
works.idea_en: Grow the whole cut instead of assembling it, and the fungus supplies the fibre structure.
works.idea_zh: 直接长出整块，而不是拼装出来，纤维结构由真菌提供。
works.method: Ecovative's aerial mycelium process grows dense mats of Ostreatus mycelium on a nutrient tray in days; the mats are cured with salt and coconut fat and cut across the grain.
works.method_zh: Ecovative 的气生菌丝工艺在营养托盘上数天内长出致密的平菇菌丝垫；菌丝垫用盐和椰子油腌制，再横纹切片。

works.title: Lovely Trash
works.description: An early series of 3D-printed objects made from waste paste and colonised by mycelium, testing how printed geometry guides fungal growth and final strength.
works.description_zh: 一批早期作品：用废料浆 3D 打印并由菌丝体定植的物件，测试打印几何如何引导真菌生长与最终强度。
works.idea_en: Printed geometry is a growth instruction for the fungus, not just a shape.
works.idea_zh: 打印几何对真菌来说是一份生长指令，而不只是一个形状。
works.method: Waste cellulose is mixed into a printable paste, printed as open lattices and ribbed vessels, inoculated with mycelium and incubated so hyphae bridge the printed gaps.
works.method_zh: 把废纤维素混成可打印浆料，打印成开放网格和带棱容器，接种菌丝体后培养，使菌丝跨越打印缝隙。

works.title: Animal-Free Whey Protein
works.description: Whey protein identical to cow's milk protein is produced by engineered fungi in fermentation tanks, and sold inside ice cream, milk and protein powders.
works.description_zh: 与牛奶蛋白相同的乳清蛋白由工程真菌在发酵罐中生产，用于冰淇淋、牛奶和蛋白粉等产品。
works.idea_en: Keep the molecule, drop the animal: the product tastes the same because the protein is the same.
works.idea_zh: 保留分子，去掉动物：产品味道一样，因为蛋白就是同一种。
works.method: The bovine beta-lactoglobulin gene is expressed in Trichoderma fungi fed sugar; the secreted protein is purified and used as a drop-in dairy ingredient.
works.method_zh: 把牛的 β-乳球蛋白基因表达在以糖为食的 Trichoderma 真菌中，分泌的蛋白经纯化后作为可直接替代的乳制品原料。

works.title: In Situ Bioprinting of Autologous Skin Cells
works.description: A wheeled bedside printer scans a wound, then deposits the patient's own skin cells directly into it, closing large full-thickness wounds faster than grafts.
works.description_zh: 一台可推到床边的打印机先扫描创面，再把病人自身的皮肤细胞直接打印进去，比植皮更快闭合大面积全层创口。
works.idea_en: Bring the printer to the body instead of printing a part and implanting it.
works.idea_zh: 把打印机带到身体旁，而不是先打印一个部件再植入。
works.method: A hand-held laser scanner builds a 3D map of the wound; the cartridge system prints fibroblasts and keratinocytes in fibrin and collagen along the mapped topography in a single pass.
works.method_zh: 手持激光扫描仪建立创面三维图；卡盒系统按该地形一次性打印纤维蛋白与胶原中的成纤维细胞和角质细胞。

paper.title: In Situ Bioprinting of Autologous Skin Cells Accelerates Wound Healing of Extensive Excisional Full-Thickness Wounds

works.title: 3D Bioprinting of Tissues and Organs
works.description: The reference review of bioprinting for non-specialists: printer types, bioink requirements, resolution limits and the vascularisation problem, laid out as a design brief.
works.description_zh: 面向非专业者的生物打印基准综述：打印机类型、生物墨水要求、分辨率极限与血管化难题，读起来像一份设计任务书。
works.idea_en: One paper that tells a designer what bioprinting can and cannot do, and why.
works.idea_zh: 一篇论文告诉设计师生物打印能做什么、不能做什么，以及为什么。
works.method: A systematic comparison of inkjet, microextrusion and laser-assisted bioprinting against the requirements of cell viability, resolution, mechanical strength and nutrient transport.
works.method_zh: 把喷墨、微挤出和激光辅助生物打印，系统对照细胞存活率、分辨率、力学强度和营养输运等要求进行比较。

paper.title: 3D bioprinting of tissues and organs

works.title: MARS II
works.description: A second generation of the modular reef system with revised geometry and casting process, shown above water at MPavilion in Melbourne before deployment.
works.description_zh: 模块化礁体系统的第二代，几何与浇注工艺经过修改，在部署前于墨尔本 MPavilion 以陆上形式展出。
works.idea_en: Iterate habitat design like a product line, with each generation testing a new geometry.
works.idea_zh: 像产品线一样迭代栖息地设计，每一代测试一种新几何。
works.method: Updated 3D-printed moulds cast ceramic modules with larger internal voids and simpler assembly; the exhibition version let visitors see the interlocking logic normally hidden underwater.
works.method_zh: 更新的 3D 打印模具浇注出内部空腔更大、拼装更简单的陶瓷模块；展览版让观众看到通常隐藏在水下的互锁逻辑。
